links.outcome: Ability of quality gates to flag B-scans that will yield unreliable segmentation before model use
links.effect: Scalar NR-IQA metrics inadequate (|r| < 0.20); ImageNet representations reached ROC-AUC up to 0.77; RETFound (OCT-specific FM) reached ROC-AUC about 0.81.
links.quote: All scalar NR-IQA metrics proved inadequate (|  r |  < 0.20).

unlisted_practices: Task-specific input quality gating using learned representations (linear probing on pretrained/foundation model embeddings) instead of device-reported scan quality scores or scalar NR-IQA metrics

links.effect: ImageNet-based pretrained representations improved upon NR-IQA, achieving ROC-AUC up to 0.77.
links.quote: General-purpose ImageNet-based pretrained representations (EfficientNet-b0, ResNet-50, ViT-B/16) improve upon NR-IQA, achieving ROC-AUC up to 0.77, indicating that learned representations are better suited to task-specific quality gating than hand-crafted scalar statistics.
